target_customer: Veterinary clinics and chains (agreement with IVC Evidensia referenced on the company site)
problem: Vets spend about 40% of their time on admin and over 20% on note taking. Vetnio records visits and generates clinical notes, emails, diagnostics help and invoices.
business_model: B2B SaaS subscription for veterinary practices
product_category: AI scribe and copilot for veterinary care

founders.name: Arman Karégar
education: KTH Royal Institute of Technology, MSc Industrial Engineering and Management
founders.background_notes: YC page says about 20 years of audio processing experience and youngest board member of two firms. A profile says he applied to YC five times before; the idea came from a stressful vet visit with his dog.

founders.name: Max Henry Xie
education: Studied industrial engineering and management at KTH, dropped out to work at Accenture
founders.background_notes: Self-taught developer who built fraud ML models for large banks.

competitors.name: ScribbleVet
competitors.traction_then: Named first education customer University of Florida in March 2025; later AmeriVet partnership with 213 hospitals (2025-07)

competitors.name: PetDesk Scribe
competitors.what: AI SOAP note and client summary scribe from a pet engagement vendor

technical_complexity.rationale: Speech-to-note scribing on commercial models is standard engineering; veterinary terminology and EU privacy add moderate work.

defensibility.rationale: Many scribes launched 2024 to 2025 and practice management vendors bundled scribes, so copying was easy; chain contracts add some stickiness.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Practice software vendors added scribes during 2025 (PetDesk and Vetspire May 2025, Otto August 2025).

market_need_then: Admin burden in vet practice is a widely cited pain point; multiple scribe launches in 2024 and 2025 show demand.

branding.domain_note: Uses vetnio.com; acquisition history not found.

identity.voice_and_tone: Direct, peer-to-peer, tagline By vets. For vets.

branding.community_and_virality: Trade press (Vet Times) covered it as the AI copilot vets cannot stop talking about; headline only seen in search, not opened.

brand_strength.rationale: Trade press coverage and a clear tagline, but no evidence yet that the brand drove growth.

outcome_analysis: Vetnio raised a 1M euro pre-seed in December 2024 led by Peak and YZR just before YC Winter 2025, and reports a deal with IVC Evidensia. It is active but small and faces many scribes, including ones bundled by practice software vendors. Later rounds were not found.
notes: Peak post gives 1M euro as the round size; amount_usd left null to avoid computing a conversion. Unverified: a June 2025 seed tranche bringing total to about 1.23M (Yespress), VCBacked lists 500K total. The IVC Evidensia agreement is mentioned on the company site but a search found no independent report. Name origin not found. Founding year not stated. Some competitor dates are slightly after the batch.
